entities.name: Emine Ülker Tarhan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Emine Ülker Tarhan is a Turkish jurist and politician from the Republican People's Party. She was formerly a judge at the High Court of Appeals. She served as the vice spokesperson of her party in the parliament before resigning on 31 October 2014. She founded the Anatolia Party on 14 November 2014 and led it until its disestablishment in December 2015.

entities.name: Emine Ülker Tarhan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Emine Ülker Tarhan is a Turkish jurist and politician from the Republican People's Party. She was formerly a judge at the High Court of Appeals. She served as the vice spokesperson of her party in the parliament before resigning on 31 October 2014. She founded the Anatolia Party on 14 November 2014 and led it until its disestablishment in December 2015.
